Authentic Mexican Guacamole
By: Mexican Food Journal
Published: Sunday, November 22, 2015 - 5:47pm

Ingredients




3 ripe avocados
¾ cup finely chopped Roma tomato
2 serrano chiles very finely chopped (seeded and deveined)
3 heaping tablespoons of finely chopped onion
3 tablespoons of minced cilantro
Salt to taste (usually about ¾ of a teaspoon)

Preparation

1 STANDARD METHOD 2 Remove the flesh of the avocados. 3 Mash the avocados with the back of a fork. 4 Add the other ingredients and incorporate evenly. 5 Add salt to taste. 6 MOLCAJETE METHOD 7 Add the chopped onion, serrano chile, cilantro and salt to the molcajete. 8 Grind until you have a smooth paste. 9 Add the avocados to the molcajete and grind until slightly chunky. 10 Add the tomatoes to the molcajete and incorporate. Do not grind the tomatoes. 11 Adjust the salt.

About

One Recipe, Two Methods of Preparation Guacamole can be prepared in two ways: with a bowl and fork or in the molcajete, a Mexican mortar end pestle. Making it in the molcajete gets the most incredible results. Let us show you both methods of preparation. See the recipe.
